title: Continuity of the forward observer: attributing every trigger the schedule lost

inputs.OS_CONTINUITY_EVIDENCE.json: the host reading, including the lane bytes pinned at the instant it was taken

declared_reading.note: the reading is a function of the committed snapshot plus the declared instant, so a re-run on another machine reaches the same numbers; --offline implies --stored-snapshot, and an offline run with no --until reads the instant back from the record it is re-deriving

reproducibility.claim: the committed audit is reproduced byte for byte from the committed inputs, without reading the lane and without rewriting the snapshot it checks
reproducibility.run_from: a working directory outside the package, with a relative --reports

proposed_definition.rendered_from: the lane's own frozen registration, so the same inputs re-render the same bytes and the definition carries no timestamp of its own
carried_over: the TimeTrigger and its original StartBoundary (the phase the audit measured)
WakeToRun=false, ExecutionTimeLimit=PT1H, IgnoreNew, StartWhenAvailable=true, RestartOnFailure 3 x PT5M
the lane's action, its arguments and its working directory
added: a LogonTrigger, enabled, Delay PT60S, additive
a witness Exec ahead of the lane's action

rehearsal.what_the_two_lines_are: the lane's action payload, replaced for the rehearsal by cmd.exe /c exit 0: running the lane's own action there would write an out-of-phase tick into the ledger this audit measures

proposed_definition.why_not_applied: re-registering a running lane's task moves the phase this audit measures; the package renders and rehearses the definition and leaves the decision to the operator

window.phase_source: measured from the ticks the host actually launched

scheduler_counters_are_not_evidence.comment: the registered task reports no missed run for the window in which 26 triggers produced no process, and the log that would have recorded them is disabled: the counters are not wrong on their own terms, they are silent about exactly the case this audit measures

long_execution.evidence: median tick 34.64 s, maximum 349.035 s, zero ticks over the 900 s interval
long_execution.comment: a tick cannot eat its successor's trigger at this duration

host_sleep_or_standby.evidence: 0 Kernel-Power sleep/resume pairs in the window; 29 power events, none of them a 42/107 pair
host_sleep_or_standby.comment: the earlier reading attributed the silence to a machine that sleeps; the host records no sleep at all

absence_of_an_interactive_session.evidence: 24 of 26 unanswered triggers fall in one 22876.438 s (6.355 h) window between a logoff at 2026-10-14T22:29:37Z and a sign-in at 2026-10-15T04:50:54Z
absence_of_an_interactive_session.comment: the task is registered LogonType=InteractiveToken, so no session means the trigger produces no process and no record; AutoAdminLogon=0, so a reboot leaves the host at the sign-in screen indefinitely

host_down.evidence: 2 reboots (Windows Update) at 2026-10-14T22:33:49Z->22:41:14Z and 22:43:07Z->22:43:21Z, 458.525 s of downtime, 1 trigger
host_down.comment: the reboots sit inside the session absence, so their cost is indistinguishable from its cost and is counted there

disk_pressure.evidence: 43 triggers fired and were refused by the storage guard (45 refusals total, 2 of them outside the cadence); volume free space fell to 0.8302 GiB with 10.764 h below the 2 GiB critical floor and 6.49 h below the 5 GiB warning floor
disk_pressure.comment: these are not scheduling losses: the guard refused before any market request, so each one cost a market call and a slot

scheduler_silence_with_the_host_up.evidence: 1 instant (2026-10-13T18:55:56Z) with the host up and a session present produced no tick and no host-side record
scheduler_silence_with_the_host_up.comment: the Task Scheduler's operational log is disabled on this host and enabling it needs administrator rights, so 'never fired' cannot be separated from 'died before writing' retroactively

volumes.why: the volume the lane already lives on

volumes.label: Google Drive
volumes.why: not NTFS, and a cloud mount that reports the host's own capacity while holding none of it

session_independence.logon_trigger: VIABLE — registered on a throwaway task, read back from the scheduler carrying MSFT_TaskLogonTrigger (Delay PT1M) alongside MSFT_TaskTimeTrigger, run on demand, then deleted
session_independence.witness_action: VIABLE — the first action wrote its line (committed under evidence/probe-scratch/) before the long action ran, so a launch whose entry point then dies has still left a trace; the dying case itself was not exercised
session_independence.s4u_task: NEEDS_ELEVATION — the registration attempt waited for input and did not complete; S4U needs the batch-logon right
session_independence.windows_service: NEEDS_ELEVATION — not attempted; a service would need administrator rights
session_independence.automatic_logon: NEEDS_CREDENTIALS — AutoAdminLogon=0 and this work package holds no credential and will not acquire one
session_independence.task_scheduler_operational_log: NEEDS_ELEVATION — the enable attempt was refused with 'Acceso denegado'
session_independence.wake_to_run: NOT_APPLICABLE — no sleep or standby was recorded, so there is nothing for the setting to recover

what_it_would_buy.logon_trigger: bounds the recovery from a sign-in to about a minute instead of up to a quarter of an hour: measured recovery was 321.41 s
what_it_would_buy.s4u: would make the 24 triggers lost to an absent session scheduleable at all
what_it_would_buy.witness: would make the 1 unattributable trigger attributable without an administrator

economic_certificate.handling: declared, not silenced: the record was correct at its own commit and its input was re-rendered one day later by its own lane; re-issuing belongs to the work package that owns the certificate

verification.independent_verifier: 16/16 PASS — scripts/edge04r_verify.py, no code shared with the audit
verification.new_check: the_proposed_definition_carries_the_registration_it_claims — compares the committed definition with the frozen registration element by element, and fails on a carried setting that was flipped with its digest kept consistent

defects_closed.DEF-EDGE04R-1: the witness probe resolved its scratch path against the caller's working directory while the task it registers runs in the repository root: the probe reported FAILED or VIABLE depending on where the reading was taken. Every declared path is anchored on REPO_ROOT
defects_closed.DEF-EDGE04R-2: the published way to check this reading could not reproduce it: no declared instant, and an offline run re-copied the live lane over the frozen snapshot before auditing it. --offline now reads the committed snapshot, never the lane, and never rewrites it; the instant is declared or read back from the record
defects_closed.DEF-EDGE04R-3: the audit's own key is trigger_loss.expected and the probes asked for expected_instants, so a hardcoded 220 stood in a sentence beside an audit that counted 221. The count is read from the audit once and quoted everywhere
defects_closed.DEF-EDGE04R-4: WakeToRun arrives as the string "False" and bool("False") is True, so the definition would have flipped a setting while claiming to carry the registration over. String settings are parsed as booleans, and the verifier compares the definition against the registration

allowed_commits: and the commits of this pass
publication.method: fast-forward only; no force push, no branch other than the lane's own
publication.read_back: recorded in GIT_STATE.json from git ls-remote, re-probed after the push rather than quoted from the command's own output
